st: Ever smaller brains, intelligence and consciousness

sec.p: In recent years, various theories have been put forward on why humans (Homo sapiens) won out over their cousin, Homo neanderthalensis.

Is social media shrinking our brains? Maybe, but so is society! It seems that precisely because of Homo sapiens' strong social connections, our cognitive capacity has been shrinking over the last 3000 years. No, it's not just Google's and Instagram's fault.
In the following paragraph, I'll share concepts taken from Being You: A New Science of Consciousness, by Anil Seth. One of the best books of 2021 according to The Economist, no small potatoes.
